title: Motivic Classes of Maps to Partial Flag Varieties

problemStatement.plain: Does the Bryan et al. motivic class formula extend from complete to partial flag varieties? We formalize the extension conjecture with q-analog infrastructure and Grassmannian motivic classes.
whyMatters: Extends a major AI-assisted theorem to broader geometric settings
Connects q-combinatorics to motivic algebraic geometry
Partial flags include Grassmannians, widely used in algebraic geometry and physics

currentState.focus: Initial problem understanding. Read problem.md and gather context.
currentState.nextAction: Read problem.md thoroughly and acquire full context.

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETED: Formalized partial flag extension (OQ-02). Proved: q-factorial = flag class, GL_n = (L-1)^n · flag · L^T(n), Grassmannian q-Pascal. 3 axioms (partial flag conjecture + moduli space), 3 sorries (duality, lines, Gaussian binomial). Gallery data created.
builtItems: q-number [n]_L and q-factorial [n]_L! infrastructure in MotivicFlagMapsPartialFlags.lean
Recursive Grassmannian motivic class via q-Pascal identity
Explicit Grassmannian computations: Gr(1,2), Gr(1,3), Gr(2,3), Gr(2,4)
GL_n q-factorial decomposition theorem (proved from mul_geom_sum)
Partial flag variety definition and motivic class factorization
Extension conjecture formalized with parabolic subgroups
insights: q-factorials [n]_L! equal complete flag variety classes [Fl_n] — bridge between q-combinatorics and algebraic geometry
GL_n decomposes as (L-1)^n · [Fl_n] · L^{T(n)} via geometric series factorization of each (L^i - 1) factor
Grassmannian motivic classes follow q-Pascal recursion, paralleling classical binomial coefficients
First non-projective Grassmannian [Gr(2,4)] = 1+L+2L²+L³+L⁴ shows Schubert cell multiplicity
Extension to partial flags naturally involves parabolic subgroups (Levi × unipotent radical)
For Grassmannians, the conjecture reduces to maps to Gr(d,n) with GL_d × GL_{n-d} × affine
nextSteps: Prove Grassmannian duality by induction on q-Pascal
Prove Gaussian binomial identity via induction
Submit duality and lines sorries to Aristotle companion file
Verify with Docker build once available
